services.desc: Rates Adults: $119.00 Child (Ages 0-11): $99.00 NOTE: Minimum of 2 people needed for tour to be conducted! Duration 6 hours Departs: Daily approximate 9:00am / returns 3-3:30pm About Visit the quaint town of Jerome on this half day tour. At one time, Jerome was among the richest towns in Arizona due to the discovery of copper and other minerals. Today, the buildings of yesteryear are home to a unique variety of shops, restaurants, galleries featuring local artists and wine tasting rooms. Your knowledgeable guide will take you up Cleopatra Hill for beautiful views and share the rich history of this area. services.name: Hopi Lands and Cultural Private Tour
services.desc: Rates Adults (Ages 13+): $399.00 Child (Ages 3-12): $369.00 Duration Approximately 10 hours About This cultural experience follows the same fascinating itinerary as our NON-private Hopi tour where you visit the oldest continuously occupied villages in the United States. Photos and electronic equipment is not allowed on this tour out of respect for the culture of the Hopi people. services.name: Grand Canyon Tour with Ruins & Volcanoes
services.desc: Enjoy our most comprehensive Grand Canyon tour with a knowledgeable and professional guide! Duration 10.5 Hours About Begin with a drive up scenic Oak Creek Canyon (Sedona departures only) and a view Arizona’s highest mountains, the San Francisco Peaks. Next, travel to Sunset Crater National Monument where you’ll have time to walk through the lava beds and view the crater that created them. The tour continues with a stop at Wupatki National Monument to view ancient Native American ruins. Afterward, enjoy panoramic views of the Painted Desert cliffs on the way to historic Cameron Trading Post on the Navajo Nation. There, you’ll have time for shopping for souvenirs and Native American arts
